rust_declaration.name: into_bytes_with_nul

must_use.reason: `self` will be dropped if the result is not used

attrs.other:
#[attr = Stability {stability: Stability {level: Stable {since: Version(RustcVersion { major: 1, minor: 7, patch: 0 })},
feature: "cstring_into"}}]

trusted_assumptions: vstd contract for CString::into_bytes: the returned vector view equals value@.
vstd contract for Vec::push: pushing 0 appends 0 to the vector view.
rationale: Rust 1.96 into_bytes extracts the same buffer and removes only its trailing NUL; immediately pushing 0 reconstructs the target result without calling the target method.
